doc: A 0.05-day rotator: Hadley edge clamped at 10 degrees, x up to 9; the scale is 0.05. 181 float64 latitudes -90..90 every degree. Float64 closed form (gaussians, a smoothstep, a scale): rtol 1e-9. Arguments: lat (input, rad), hadley_deg and body (params). Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 9.4e-16 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 5e4x that spread.
